2002) is a Canadian [[college basketball]] player for the [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette Golden Eagles]]. ==Early life and high school== Prosper grew up in [[Montreal]], [[Quebec]], Canada.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/01/10/marquettes-olivier-maxence-prosper-latest-montreal-basketball-talent/9155852002/|title=Marquette's Olivier-Maxence Prosper latest Montreal basketball talent|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=January 10, 2022|access-date=May 7, 2023}} He initially attended L'Académie Ste-Thérèse, which did not have a basketball team.{{cite web|url=https://www.journaldemontreal.com/2019/12/27/tombe-dans-la-potion-des-son-enfance|title=Académie de la NBA: Olivier-Maxence Prosper est tombé dans la potion dès son enfance|work=[[Le Journal de Montréal]]|date=December 27, 2019|access-date=May 7, 2023|language=French}} When Prosper was 16 he enrolled at [[Lake Forest Academy]] in [[Lake Forest, Illinois]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/lake-forest/sports/ct-lfr-oliver-maxence-prosper-basketball-without-borders-tl-0808-20190803-j4yzclhjsfa47ichus4gy3phy4-story.html|title=From Montreal to Medellin: Lake Forest Academy junior thrives at Basketball Without Borders camp|work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=August 3, 2019|access-date=May 5, 2023}} Prosper transferred to the [[NBA Academy]] Latin America in [[Mexico City]], [[Mexico]] to finish his high school career.{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/4312175/2023/03/16/bennedict-mathurin-latin-american-academy-indiana-pacers/|title=How the Latin American NBA Academy helped save Bennedict Mathurin|first=Joe|last=Vardon|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=March 16, 2023|access-date=May 5, 2023}} He was rated a four-star recruit and committed to play [[college basketball]] at [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]].{{cite web|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2019/clemson-adds-another-major-basketball-recruit-in-4-star-f-olivier-maxence-prosper|title=Clemson adds another major basketball recruit in 4-star F Olivier-Maxence Prosper|first=Cam|last=Smith|website=USATodayHSS.com|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=October 25, 2019|access-date=May 7, 2023}} ==College career== Prosper began his college career at [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/10/28/marquette-basketballs-olivier-maxence-prosper-could-help-scoring-load/69598233007/|title=Marquette basketball's Olivier-Maxence Prosper could help scoring load|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=October 24, 2022|access-date=May 5, 2023}} He averaged ten minutes of play and 2.5 points per game as a freshman.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/clemson/mens-basketball/clemson-tigers-freshman-olivier-maxence-prosper-enters-transfer-portal|title=Clemson's Prosper Enters Transfer Portal|first=Brad|last=Senkiw|website=[[SI.com]]|date=March 24, 2021|access-date=May 5, 2023}} After the season Prosper entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://www.greenvilleonline.com/story/sports/2021/03/24/clemson-basketball-loses-olivier-maxence-prosper-ncaa-transfer-portal/6989247002/|title=Clemson basketball loses Olivier-Maxence Prosper to transfer portal; second player this week|work=[[The Greenville News]]|date=March 24, 2021|access-date=May 5, 2023}} Prosper ultimately transferred to [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2021/04/15/marquette-adds-clemson-transfer-olivier-maxence-prosper/7235346002/|title=Marquette adds Clemson transfer Olivier-Maxence Prosper|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=April 15, 2021|access-date=May 5, 2023}} He averaged 6.6 points and 3.3 rebounds in his first season season with the Golden Eagles.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/06/16/olivier-maxence-prosper-oso-ighodaro-have-bigger-roles-for-marquette-golden-eagles/7639510001/|title=Olivier-Maxence Prosper, Oso Ighodaro have bigger roles for Marquette|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=June 16, 2022|access-date=May 7, 2023}} Prosper averaged 12.5 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 0.9 steals per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/2023/04/nba-draft-olivier-maxence-prosper-sleeper-marquette|title=Why NBA teams looking for the next OG Anunoby should consider drafting Olivier-Maxence Prosper|first=Bryan|last=Kalbrosky|website=[[USA Today]]|date=April 12, 2023|access-date=May 7, 2023}} After the season, he entered the [[2023 NBA draft]],{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2023/04/12/marquettes-olivier-maxence-prosper-puts-name-into-nba-draft/70107462007/|title=Marquette's Olivier-Maxence Prosper puts name into 2023 NBA draft|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=April 12, 2023|access-date=May 5, 2023}} showcasing impressive performances at the [[NBA Draft Combine]]. ==Personal life== Prosper's parents, Guylaine and Gaetan, both played college basketball at [[Concordia University]] and were both mulitple-time [[Réseau du sport étudiant du Québec|RSEQ]] All-Stars.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/montreal-siblings-pro-hoop-dreams-1.6725219|title=Montreal's Olivier-Maxence Prosper inches closer to NBA dream while helping star sister|first=Abdulhamid|last=Ibrahim|website=[[CBC.ca]]|agency=[[The Canadian Press]]|date=January 25, 2023|access-date=May 7, 2023}} His sister, Cassandre, plays basketball for [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish women's basketball|Notre Dame]].{{cite web|url=https://www.journaldemontreal.com/2023/03/17/march-madness-un-excellent-depart-pour-le-quebecois-olivier-maxence-prosper-1|title=March Madness: un
